description: This file defines the class Vtiger_Unzip which extends dUnzip2 to facilitate zip file extraction with additional features such as path checking, directory verification, and advanced extraction with renaming and exclusion options. It provides methods to handle zip file operations in the context of vtiger CRM.

classes.name: Vtiger_Unzip
classes.description: A class extending dUnzip2 to provide enhanced zip extraction features such as path validation, directory creation, renaming, and exclusion handling.

methods.name: __checkPathInArray
methods.description: Checks if the given path starts with any of the paths in the provided array, used for filtering paths.

methods.name: isdir
methods.description: Determines if a given filepath represents a directory based on trailing slash.

methods.name: unzipAllEx
methods.description: Performs an extended unzip operation, allowing for renaming, inclusion/exclusion filtering, directory structure maintenance, and permission setting.
